name: Transparent video background removal
oneLine: Remove video and animation backgrounds with clean moving edges, preserve accents, and verify alpha transparency in MOV, WebM and GIF deliveries.
description: A local pale-plate matting and quality-check workflow with an authorized host handoff for CUE; not a native product execution tool.
inputs: Inspected subject seed and plate/mask settings
outputs: Alpha ProRes4444 master with preserved compatible audio
Optional transparent GIF with format limitations
acceptance: Source pixels, identity, frame geometry and timing preserved
Facial whites remain while true negative spaces are transparent
Intentional detached accents retained with inspected fade
All output alpha planes/frame counts decoded and checked
Visual review scope and residual uncertainty stated
